# Bon Accord Psychology

> Psychotherapy in Rotterdam for English- and Chinese-speaking expats and international students. Provided by Tak Tsun (Edmund) Lo, a Rotterdam-based clinical psychologist with research training in Hong Kong and the Netherlands.

Bon Accord Psychology (also: Bon Accord Psycholoog, Bon Accord Psychological Services) is a solo clinical-psychology practice based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. The practice serves English-, Cantonese-, and Mandarin-speaking adults — primarily expats and international students — in person in Rotterdam and online. Areas of focus include depression, anxiety, anger, grief, and other emotional difficulties, using Emotion-Focused Therapy (EFT), EMDR, and CBT.

The practitioner, Edmund Lo, is registered as Psychologist NIP (NL, registration 247500) and as a Clinical Psychologist on the HKSAR Department of Health Accredited Register (HK, registration 204344). He has completed his PhD training in Developmental Psychopathology from Radboud University and a Master in Clinical Psychology from The Chinese University of Hong Kong. He is also an EFT- and EMDR-trained therapist and an active researcher in emotion dynamics and adolescent mental health.
